name: Principle-following pass rate under standing instructions
purpose: Share of scenarios (all principles, a share held out) whose reply the model judge passes, in two settings (a chat completion and the deep-run prompt with tools off) and two instruction sets (the shipped standing instructions and none); a regex on each case's forbidden phrasing is a cheap prefilter only; offline validity: the reference good replies pass and the reference bad replies fail Read in this direction: raise the share of scenarios whose reply does what the principle asks. This is a tie, not a win: the recorded rows are stratified samples at the cheapest tier and the same arms moved by several cases between two same-day recordings, so a lead of a few cases is inside the noise. The judge and the replies are the same small model, the in-situ arm has no tools (it scores the stated plan, not a diff from a real task), and calibration against Joshua's verdicts is pending his review of cases.csv.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of each implementation on the same cases, with the recorded cost as the tie-break; each run is one row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash, and the leaderboard compares rows only when the hash matches.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the reference_good no-model arm of esoi_behavior runs the whole case set with no model call, validating the cases and scorer before any model is paid for] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > live [real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=a person approved the spend under the metric run policy]

name: Judge agreement with labelled reference replies

The labels come from the case author, who also wrote the regex checks, so agreement shows the judge is not broken, not that it matches Joshua's reading.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of each implementation on the same cases, with the recorded cost as the tie-break; each run is one row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash, and the leaderboard compares rows only when the hash matches.

name: Secret detection and placeholder tolerance
purpose: offline cases: planted secrets assembled from fragments (keys, tokens, private key block, home paths, object id, address), documented placeholders that must stay quiet, the repository clean in file groups, command runs in a throwaway git repo; zero model calls Read in this direction: maximise detection of every known secret kind planted in text; minimise false findings on documented placeholders; keep the repository itself scanning clean. The scan reads working files unless `esoi hygiene --history` is asked for, and knows only the secret shapes in the esoi hygiene scanner, so a vendor token with a new shape passes until the scanner gains a pattern and a planted case is added.

name: Right solution missed without the tag
purpose: Measures whether the tags identify the solutions a change must consult, in two parts. Recorded now, offline: the mechanical half of the first milestone, on fixture tag files (evaluation/components/tag_solutions): the rule passes a good file and fails each fault a person can make without judgement (a tag with no problem link, with no meaning, on every solution, used by none, linking a problem id that is not a record, a tag outside the list, a problem id copied into the tags column), and the lookup finds a solution through its tags and through its connected problems.
record: Offline part: per case, the rule's problem lines and notes against the faults the case names, or the solutions the lookup returns; one row per run pinned to the commit and the cases hash, with no model call, and the deliberately broken baseline (esoi run tag_solutions --impl tag_solutions.broken.membership_only:build, run by hand because a metric command names arms under impls/ only) must fail. Planned part: per tag, the share of labelled requests where the right solution is missed without it, against the share with all tags.
disadvantages: Planned and unmeasured until search-cards-and-specs and its labelled requests exist: whether each tag mitigates the problems it links, as the share of labelled requests where a solution that covers or constrains the change is missed with the tags and with each tag removed in turn; a tag whose removal misses nothing more is retired.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the tag_list_with_check offline arm of tag_solutions runs the whole case set with no model call]
